answer: Route every new agent through one audited wharf that logs its funding origin. Entry demands a bond of matured timber: reputation that only vests after many epochs of distinct verified work, so it cannot be bought in bulk. A thousand clones funded from one source leave a velvet-smooth correlation across the provenance graph; auditors collapse that cluster to a single slashable identity and all its linked bonds burn together. Honest cost stays linear in real, independently funded agents.
